title: Cat Gomoku Privacy Policy
summary: TeamCP operates Cat Gomoku for Android (com.teamcp.catgomoku). You can play as a guest without signing up. We do not collect a name, email, phone number or Google password for our own registration. Depending on the features you choose, the game uses Google Play Games, Firebase online matches, Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads.

sections.title: 1. Scope
paragraphs: TeamCP operates Cat Gomoku for Android (com.teamcp.catgomoku). You can play as a guest without signing up. We do not collect a name, email, phone number or Google password for our own registration. Depending on the features you choose, the game uses Google Play Games, Firebase online matches, Unity LevelPlay and Unity Ads.

sections.title: 2. Information on your device
paragraphs: The app stores your guest identifier, match record, puzzle/challenge/tower progress, achievements, currency, cats and cosmetic unlocks/selections, reward history, language, audio and vibration settings in private Android app storage. Usage analysis and diagnostic logs are local implementations and are not sent to an external analytics or automatic crash-reporting server. Ad consent is stored as a device setting and excluded from Google Play Games Saved Games.

Android auto backup is allowed, so app data may be included in Android backups depending on your device and Google account settings. The exclusion of ad consent from cloud saves refers to Google Play Games Saved Games, not an exclusion from Android backup.

sections.title: 3. Google Play Games connection
paragraphs: Connecting Google Play Games is optional. Google may process authentication status, player identifier and display name. Match records, puzzle/challenge progress, currency, cat/cosmetic unlocks, settings, achievement completion and incremental progress may be sent to Saved Games and achievements to provide cross-device saving/restoration and achievements.

sections.title: 4. Online 1:1 matches
paragraphs: Choosing online matches uses Google Firebase anonymous authentication and Realtime Database. It may process anonymous UID, display name, selected cat, Elo rating, tier, wins/losses/draws and ranking, matchmaking state, room identifier, move coordinates, connection status, match results and processing times. Purposes are matchmaking, real-time synchronization, result settlement, rankings and abuse prevention.

sections.title: 5. Ads and data processing
paragraphs: Unity LevelPlay mediates ads supplied by Unity Ads and ironSource (an ad network in Unity LevelPlay mediation): banner, interstitial and optional rewarded ads. Providers may process IP address and approximate region, device model, OS/app version, language, network information, permitted advertising/device identifiers, ad requests, impressions, clicks, viewing completion and ad error/diagnostic data. Purposes are ad delivery, frequency limits, measurement, fraud prevention and personalized ads if you agree. Actual processing depends on region, Android settings, consent and provider policies.

sections.title: 6. Your ad consent choice
paragraphs: On first launch every user sees the app’s own consent card and chooses personalized ads or only non-personalized ads. Before a choice, the ad SDK is not started and no ads are requested. Declining personalization does not reduce the number of ads; it sends LevelPlay a consent refusal and sale/sharing opt-out signal (do_not_sell=true). You can choose again in Settings at any time and control advertising ID/privacy in Android settings. Rewarded viewing is optional, and failure to load ads is designed not to block game progress.

sections.title: 7. Issue reports
paragraphs: To submit a report, write a description in Settings > “Report a problem / Contact” and tap Send. The app does not send automatic crash reports. A report contains the following information.
items: The description you write (up to 2,000 characters) and the report type you pick
Attached automatically: app identifier and version, the name of the screen you reported from, app language, device model name, and a random report number created for each report
after: If a report cannot be sent, it is stored on your device and may be retried when the connection returns.

Reports never include your advertising ID, an account, your game records or your location. Please do not write personal information such as your name or contact details in the description. Reports are sent over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and stored on a report server operated by TeamCP (web hosting: Cafe24, Republic of Korea), and are used only to find and fix problems. The server and the hosting company may process your IP address in connection logs while the request is handled. Reports stored on the server are kept for 90 days from the day they are received and then deleted.

sections.title: 8. Providers and international processing
paragraphs: Google Play Games provides optional login, cloud saves and achievements; Google Firebase provides anonymous authentication, online matches and rankings; Unity LevelPlay / Unity Ads / ironSource provides ad mediation, delivery, measurement and fraud prevention. Each provider may retain or process data abroad under its policy. TeamCP does not sell user information. See Unity’s policy for advertising rights and sale/sharing opt-out procedures.

sections.title: 9. Retention and data deletion
paragraphs: Delete device data with the app’s data reset, Android Clear app data, or uninstalling. Manage Google Play Games data with the app’s Google Play data deletion and Google account controls; Google’s retention policy applies. Firebase profiles, ratings and match information are kept as needed for online features and abuse prevention; contact us to request deletion. Unity’s retention/deletion policies and rights procedures apply to ad data; uninstalling alone does not delete data already processed by ad providers. Send your app name and request, never passwords or identity documents.
Reports you sent: email teamcp.channel@gmail.com with the date you sent it and your device model (and, if possible, part of the text), and we will find and delete it.

sections.title: 10. Your rights
paragraphs: Guest single-player does not require Google Play Games or online matches. Contact teamcp.channel@gmail.com to request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection or consent withdrawal as available in your region. For data TeamCP does not hold, we will direct you to the provider’s procedure.

sections.title: 11. Children
paragraphs: The game is not designed specifically for children; its current store target audience is age 13 and over. Content ratings do not designate a child-directed service. The ad service is told that the app is not child-directed. If we learn that we directly collected a child’s personal information without required guardian consent, we take appropriate steps including deletion.

sections.title: 12. Security and policy changes
paragraphs: Local data stays in private Android app storage. Google Play Games, Firebase and ad services use their providers’ secure communication methods; service access and Firebase security rules are limited as needed. We update this policy and date when information, providers or features change and announce important changes in the app, store or this page.
